newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago trusts file $1 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago trusts file $1 mln preferred.

text.p: Four business trusts formed by First Chicago NBD Corp filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1.0 million in preferred securities.

The trusts, known as First Chicago NBD Capital I, First Chicago Capital II, First Chicago NBD Capital III and First Chicago NBC Capital IV, will use proceeds from the offering to invest in subordinated debt securities of the parent.
The parent will in turn use funds for general corporate purposes, including the funding of investments in or extensions of credit to, its subsidiaries.
